_comment: Routing tests for skill descriptions. should_trigger: the prompt must load this skill. should_not_trigger: it must not (another skill, or none, is fine). Near misses belong in should_not_trigger. Explicit-only skills (disable-model-invocation: true) only have should_not_trigger cases: they guard against that flag being removed. Run: node evals/run-triggers.js
